{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Calculate the fraction of patients with severe baseline disease
severe_count = trial_df['severity'].value_counts()['severe']
total_patients = len(trial_df)
fraction_severe = severe_count / total_patients

severe_count, total_patients, fraction_severe"}
